mapper.select: SELECT a.activation_sequence AS activationSequence, a.directive_id AS directiveId, a.directive_json AS directiveJson, a.applied_at AS appliedAt FROM mk_bundle_admission_pointer p JOIN mk_bundle_applied_authorization a ON a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND a.environment_name=p.environment_name AND a.cell_id=p.cell_id AND a.campaign_id=p.campaign_id AND a.activation_sequence=p.applied_sequence WHERE p.tenant_id=#{key.tenantId} AND p.environment_name=#{key.environment} AND p.cell_id=#{key.cell} AND p.campaign_id=#{key.campaignId} FOR SHARE
